Definition: accusative case singular masculine of G3778; this (person, as objective of verb or preposition):--him, the same, that, this.
BiblicalUsage: This man, this one — the word that singles a person out. Jesus says all men cannot receive this saying, Simon of Cyrene is the man they compelled to bear the cross, and Jesus warns that whoever is ashamed of Him, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word is sharpest where it points at a person: this saying, this man, and the shame or the honour that follows.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
